Name: Fishking's All the villagers Portraits 1.6 Available
Author: Whalefishkinghhh
Description:
此版本的美化包含冬季服装。

需要安装[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url] 。

需要两个前置模组，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]写照[/url]以及[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]内容补丁程序[/url]。

模组安装方法：

首先下载解压并安装尾号999的Portraiture模组，将该模组拉进星露谷mod文件夹

点开Portraiture文件夹，再点开Portraits文件夹，将下载并解压好的[CP] Fishking1.6文件夹直接放进Portraits文件夹中，模组就安装好了

ps：进入游戏对话后需要按P键启动头像

This version of beautification includes winter clothing.

SMAPI installation is required.

Two front-end modules, a portrait, and a content patch program are required.

This version only has walkable characters. Clicking on the My Author interface also provides a beautification module for all villagers. In addition, SVE beautification is currently being developed

Module installation method:

Firstly, download, decompress, and install the Portrait module ending in 999. Pull the module into the Stardew Valley mod folder

Open the Portrait folder, then click on the Portraits folder, and place the downloaded and extracted [CP] Fishking1.6 folder directly into the Portraits folder. The module will be installed

PS: After entering the game conversation, you need to press the P key to start the avatar

Downloads.Description: Please refer to the description interface for installation methods
